about:
# Better Progress Bar

Adds custom images to your progress bar along with two indicators in-game.

## Credits

#### Mod Icons

- <c-00ff4c>D</c><c-19ff5e>o</c><c-32ff6f>m</c><c-4bff81>i</c><c-64ff93>n</c><c-7dffa6>o</c><c-97ffba>K</c><c-b0ffcd>i</c><c-9effb1>d</c><c-77ff7f>d</c><c-50ff4c>o</c><c-29ff1a>o</c>

## Additions

- Silver indicator for the session best.
- <co>Gold</c> indicator for the level best.

#### Custom Progress Bars

- Locally upload your own image file (RECCOMENDED 823x32 MAX 1000x1000)
- Pick from the database

## Support

Open a ticket on the GitHub repo ^^

changelog:
# 1.0.5
- Remove console spam (im dumb)
- Add toggles for indicators
# 1.0.4
- BUG FIXES:
    - Hid default progress bar unless in use
    - Fix issues with the default progress bar:
        - Default bar can now be selected mid run properly
        - Fix changing bars when opening level with default bar
    - Indicators no longer update when in practice mode
# 1.0.3
- Fix huge lag issue with large images
- Add 1000x1000 file size limit to custom bars
# 1.0.2
- First Release! (sorta)
